#pragma once
#include <bits/stdc++.h>

class LazySegTree {
public:
    LazySegTree() = default;
    explicit LazySegTree(const std::vector<long long>& a) { build(a); }

    void build(const std::vector<long long>& a) {
        n_ = (int)a.size();
        if (!n_) return;
        st_.assign(4 * n_, 0);
        lazy_.assign(4 * n_, 0);
        buildRec(1, 0, n_ - 1, a);
    }

    void rangeAdd(int l, int r, long long val) { updateRec(1, 0, n_ - 1, l, r, val); }

    long long rangeSum(int l, int r) { return queryRec(1, 0, n_ - 1, l, r); }

private:
    int n_ = 0;
    std::vector<long long> st_, lazy_;

    void buildRec(int p, int l, int r, const std::vector<long long>& a) {
        if (l == r) { st_[p] = a[l]; return; }
        int m = (l + r) / 2;
        buildRec(p * 2, l, m, a);
        buildRec(p * 2 + 1, m + 1, r, a);
        st_[p] = st_[p * 2] + st_[p * 2 + 1];
    }

    void apply(int p, int l, int r, long long val) {
        st_[p] += (r - l + 1) * val;
        lazy_[p] += val;
    }

    void push(int p, int l, int r) {
        if (lazy_[p] != 0 && l != r) {
            int m = (l + r) / 2;
            apply(p * 2, l, m, lazy_[p]);
            apply(p * 2 + 1, m + 1, r, lazy_[p]);
            lazy_[p] = 0;
        } else if (l == r) {
            lazy_[p] = 0;
        }
    }

    void updateRec(int p, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, long long val) {
        if (qr < l || r < ql) return;
        if (ql <= l && r <= qr) { apply(p, l, r, val); return; }
        push(p, l, r);
        int m = (l + r) / 2;
        updateRec(p * 2, l, m, ql, qr, val);
        updateRec(p * 2 + 1, m + 1, r, ql, qr, val);
        st_[p] = st_[p * 2] + st_[p * 2 + 1];
    }

    long long queryRec(int p, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
        if (qr < l || r < ql) return 0;
        if (ql <= l && r <= qr) return st_[p];
        push(p, l, r);
        int m = (l + r) / 2;
        return queryRec(p * 2, l, m, ql, qr) + queryRec(p * 2 + 1, m + 1, r, ql, qr);
    }
};

// Inorder iterative
vector<int> inorderIter(TreeNode* root){
    vector<int> res; stack<TreeNode*> st; TreeNode* cur=root;
    while(cur || !st.empty()){
        while(cur){ st.push(cur); cur=cur->left; }
        cur=st.top(); st.pop(); res.push_back(cur->val); cur=cur->right;
    }
    return res;
}

// Preorder iterative
vector<int> preorderIter(TreeNode* root){
    vector<int> res; if(!root) return res; stack<TreeNode*> st; st.push(root);
    while(!st.empty()){
        TreeNode* n=st.top(); st.pop(); res.push_back(n->val);
        if(n->right) st.push(n->right);
        if(n->left) st.push(n->left);
    }
    return res;
}

// Postorder iterative (two stacks)
vector<int> postorderIter(TreeNode* root){
    vector<int> res; if(!root) return res; stack<TreeNode*> s1,s2; s1.push(root);
    while(!s1.empty()){
        TreeNode* n=s1.top(); s1.pop(); s2.push(n);
        if(n->left) s1.push(n->left);
        if(n->right) s1.push(n->right);
    }
    while(!s2.empty()) { res.push_back(s2.top()->val); s2.pop(); }
    return res;
}

#pragma once
#include <bits/stdc++.h>

class Trie {
public:
    struct Node {
        std::array<int, 26> nxt{};
        bool end = false;
        int pass = 0;
        Node() { nxt.fill(-1); }
    };

    Trie() { nodes_.push_back(Node()); }

    void insert(const std::string& s) {
        int cur = 0;
        for (char c : s) {
            int i = c - 'a';
            if (nodes_[cur].nxt[i] == -1) {
                nodes_[cur].nxt[i] = (int)nodes_.size();
                nodes_.push_back(Node());
            }
            cur = nodes_[cur].nxt[i];
            nodes_[cur].pass++;
        }
        nodes_[cur].end = true;
    }

    bool search(const std::string& s) const {
        int cur = 0;
        for (char c : s) {
            int i = c - 'a';
            int nxt = nodes_[cur].nxt[i];
            if (nxt == -1) return false;
            cur = nxt;
        }
        return nodes_[cur].end;
    }

    bool starts_with(const std::string& pre) const {
        int cur = 0;
        for (char c : pre) {
            int i = c - 'a';
            int nxt = nodes_[cur].nxt[i];
            if (nxt == -1) return false;
            cur = nxt;
        }
        return true;
    }

private:
    std::vector<Node> nodes_;
};

    for(int i=0;i<text.size();++i){

vector<int> zFunction(const string& s){
    int n=s.size(); vector<int> z(n); int l=0,r=0; z[0]=n;
    for(int i=1;i<n;++i){
        if(i<=r) z[i]=min(r-i+1, z[i-l]);
        while(i+z[i]<n && s[z[i]]==s[i+z[i]]) z[i]++;
        if(i+z[i]-1>r){ l=i; r=i+z[i]-1; }

int rabinKarp(const string& text, const string& pat){
    const long long B=911382323, M=972663749; int n=text.size(), m=pat.size();
    if(m>n) return -1; long long h=0, t=0, power=1;
    for(int i=0;i<m;++i){ h=(h*B+pat[i])%M; t=(t*B+text[i])%M; if(i<m-1) power=(power*B)%M; }
    if(h==t && text.substr(0,m)==pat) return 0;
    for(int i=m;i<n;++i){
        t = (t - text[i-m]*power)%M; if(t<0) t+=M;
        t = (t*B + text[i])%M;
        if(t==h && text.substr(i-m+1,m)==pat) return i-m+1;
    }
    return -1;
}

docs.title: Union-Find (Disjoint Set Union)
docs.text: Union-Find maintains a collection of disjoint sets with near constant-time merges and finds. Essential for connectivity, MST, and component tracking.

docs.title: At a Glance
docs.text:
Operation Complexity (amortized) Notes makeSet O(n) total Initialize parent, rank/size find α(n) ≈ constant Path compression union α(n) ≈ constant Union by rank / size

α(n) is the inverse Ackermann function (< 5 for all practical n).

docs.title: Implementation (C++)
docs.text:
#pragma once
#include <bits/stdc++.h>

class DSU {
public:
    DSU() = default;
    explicit DSU(int n) { init(n); }

    void init(int n) {
        parent_.resize(n);
        size_.assign(n, 1);
        std::iota(parent_.begin(), parent_.end(), 0);
        comps_ = n;
    }

    int find(int x) {
        return parent_[x] == x ? x : parent_[x] = find(parent_[x]);
    }

    bool unite(int a, int b) {
        a = find(a); b = find(b);
        if (a == b) return false;
        if (size_[a] < size_[b]) std::swap(a, b);
        parent_[b] = a;
        size_[a] += size_[b];
        --comps_;
        return true;
    }

    int size(int x) { return size_[find(x)]; }
    int components() const { return comps_; }

private:
    std::vector<int> parent_, size_;
    int comps_ = 0;
};

docs.title: Kruskal Skeleton
docs.text:
struct Edge { int u,v,w; };
int kruskal(int n, vector<Edge>& edges){
    sort(edges.begin(), edges.end(), [](auto& a, auto& b){ return a.w < b.w; });
    DSU d(n); int cost=0; for(auto& e: edges){ if(d.unite(e.u,e.v)) cost += e.w; }
    return cost;
}

docs.text:
• Forgetting path compression (performance degrade)
  • Union by value not representative (duplicate parents)
  • Mishandling 1-based vs 0-based indexing
  • Not tracking component count for queries
  • Using recursion in deep trees without compression (stack risk)
